# Team Workflow

## 1. People and machines

| Person | Owns | Main machine |
|---|---|---|
| Aditya Shah | ML + acquisition (method 5 core), benchmark, demo | `mbp`: MacBook Pro M6, 32 GB |
| CFD owner (TODO) | Geometry, OpenFOAM, verification, reference grid, patient anatomy | `pc`: Ryzen 5 7600X, 32 GB, RTX 5060 Ti, WSL2 |
| Data & validation owner (TODO) | Literature values, growth scenarios, phantom, cross-checks, statistics review | own laptop (no CFD needed) |

- Both `pc` and `mbp` run CFD during the grid phase; only the CFD owner does CFD work.
- On `mbp`, Aditya only starts/stops the worker and pushes summaries.
- Fastest machine runs the bottleneck: CFD until the grid is done, then benchmark sweeps.

## 2. How CFD cases are split
1. Reference grid = designs x growth states x conditions x virtual patients; one case per
   combination in `cases/manifest.csv`.
2. Week-1 benchmark (same case on pc and mbp) -> cases/hour -> shares.
3. `assign_cases.py --shares pc=..,mbp=..` -> each case gets exactly one machine.
4. Workers write `results/summaries/<case_id>.json`; everyone pushes; `git pull` merges.
5. `rebalance.py` reassigns only unfinished cases.

## 6. Work-session loop
1. `git pull`; pick your task (one owner per task on the board).
2. Before-you-prompt check: goal in 2 sentences? research done? know a correct result?
3. Copy a template from `prompts/templates/`; set AREA (cfd / ml / data / shared).
4. Run Claude Code in the repo; confirm the prompt file + LOG.md row exist.
5. Approve the PLAN only if you understand it; read every new file.
6. `pytest` + known-answer check; fill in "Reviewed by"; data book entry.
7. Commit on your branch (`ml/`, `cfd/`, `data/`), push, PR; another owner reviews.
8. Daily text: Done / Next / Blocked / Grid status / Data-dir size.

## 7. Prompt templates by owner

| ML | CFD | Data & validation |
|---|---|---|
| phase0 (shared), phase1, phase5, helper_tutor_method5, phase6, phase10, phase9 (shared) | phase2, phase3, phase4, phase7 | phase8 (phantom), custom_task for literature/config tools |

## 8. AI rules quick card
- Every prompt saved + logged; web chats exported to `prompts/<area>/chats/`
- AI code marked; "Reviewed by" filled in after you read it
- No AI writing of research plan, abstract, paper, board; no AI-invented numbers,
  citations, conclusions, or future work; method 5 core is Aditya's code
